content: Balaamey Yootida Koyro Tinbite
Balaamey Baalaaqe, «Ne taas hayssan laappun yarsho yarshanaasota ooththa; qasseka laappun korma booratanne laappun dorsa dharshota taas haa ekka ya» gides.
Balaaqey Balaamey izas yootida mala ooththides; istti nam7ay yarsho yarshizasohota bolla issi issi korma booranne issi issi dharsho yarsho shiishshida.

Hessafe guye Balaamey Balaaqes, «Xoossi haa taakko Yaanaakkonne yonttaakko tani gede baada erana gakkanaas neni hayssan xuugettiza yarshoza achchan eqqaashsha; GODAY taas qonccisikko hessa ta nees wursa yootana» gides; hessafe guye Balaamey barkka pude dhoqqaso kezides.
Heen Xoossi izara gayttides; Balaameykka, «Tani laappun yarsho yarshizasohota giigsadis; yarsho yarshizasohota issaa issaa bolla issi issi korma booranne issi issi dharsho yarshadis» gides.
GODAYKKA Balaamey Balaaqes yootanaas bessiza kiita izas yootidaappe guye Balaaqekko simmi baana mala yootides.
Izikka guye simmi bishin Balaaqey Mo7aabe ayssiza daannata ubbaara issife he xuugettiza yarshoza achchan eqqida mala demmides.
Hessafe guye Balaamey haasaya doommidi,
Balaaqey Balaames, «Hayssi ne ta bolla ooththidayssi aazee? Tani nena haa ehiday ne ta morkketa qangganaassa; neni gidikko istta anjjo anjjadasa attiin qanggabeekka» gides.
Balaameykka zaaridi, «GODAY taas qonccisidayssa xalla ta yootanaas bessennee?» gides.
Balaamey Yootida Nam7anththo Tinbite
Balaaqey Balaames, «Isra7eele asaa kumeththaa gidontta isttafe guuththati nees beettizaso gede haraso tanara issife baada ne istta heen taas qanggarkkii!» gides.
Hessafekka pude Pizga zumaa hu7en diza Xoofime demba efides; heenkka laappun yarsho yarshizaso giigsidi issi issi yarshizasoza bolla issi issi korma booranne dharsho yarshides.
Balaamey Balaaqes, «Neni hayssa xuugettiza yarshoza matan eqqaashsha; tani GODAARA gayttana gede bays» gides.
GODAYKKA Balaamera heen gayttides; izi yootana kiitaa izas yootidi neni Balaaqekko simma baada hayssa ha kiitaa izas yoota.
Izi simmi bishin Balaaqey Mo7aabe dereza kaaleththizaytara he xuugettiza yarshoza matan eqqida mala demmides; Balaaqeyka GODAY izas ay yootidaakko iza oychchides.
Hessafe guye Balaaqey Balaames, «Neni Isra7eele asaa qanggontta ixxida mala istta anjjoka anjjofa!» gides.
Balaameykka, «Tani kase nees GODAY taas yootooro xalla ta ooththana gaada yootabeekkinaa?» gides.
Balaamey Yootida Heedzdzanththo Tinbite
Balaaqeyka, «Haa ya ane hayssafe haraso boos; oonee erizay neni heen daada hayssa dereza taas qanggana mala Xoossi nees ero gontta aggenna» gides.
Hessa gishshas Balaaqey Balaame gede bazzo ginara diza Pe7oore zumaa hu7e ekki kezides.
Balaameykka iza, «Hayssan taas laappun yarsho yarshizaso giigsa; laappun korma booratanne laappun dharshota haa taas ekka ya» gides.
Balaaqeyka Balaamey izas yootida mala ooththides; yarsho yarshizasoza bolla issi issi korma booranne issi issi dharsho yarsho shiishshides.
